messages:
olivia: quick flag  the sample-worker demo is failing in Cloudflare with a weird prototype error. suspect dual-pkg resolution.
sam: paste the failure?
olivia: `TypeError: Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'prototype')` when initializing Client. Happens only when import via `import 'our-sdk'` in worker.
diego: likely the CJS bundle leaking into the edge runtime. Can you share package.json exports?
olivia: snippet: 

```
"exports": {
  ".": {
    "types": "./dist/index.d.ts",
    "import": "./dist/esm/index.mjs",
    "require": "./dist/cjs/index.cjs"
  }
}
```

olivia: We also ship a small runtime auth helper that conditionally requires node libs for Node. Looks like that `require()` made it into the ESM build.
sam: that's the root cause. ESM entry must be free of `require()` and CommonJS shims. Some bundlers will still pick main or rewrite imports and pull CJS.
diego: two axes: publishing metadata (exports/main/module/browser) + build hygiene (no require in esm). I propose:
- Add "browser": "./dist/esm/index.mjs" to exports to bias bundlers to ESM for browser/edge.
- Add CI lint that scans dist/esm for `require(` or `module.exports`.
- Factor auth/retry into a pure ESM source file used by both bundles so parity is guaranteed.
sam: also types oddities: TS sometimes resolves to different declaration when exports mapping is ambiguous. Add explicit "./types": {"types": "./dist/index.d.ts"} export to be safe and run `tsc --traceResolution` in CI against a sample consumer.
olivia: will collect a minimal worker repro and add to the sample-app tests.
diego: I'll open a PR with the lint job and an esm-sanity check. CI-bot will gate.
ci-bot: ci/checks  added esm-scan and tsc-resolution checks to matrix on PR #420.
sam: temporary mitigation: point `main` at the esm build to reduce edge fallout until we fix transforms, but beware breaking old CJS `require()` consumers. Probably ok as a short-lived safety patch.
olivia: thanks all, repro + doc note for onboarding will be in the PR. :thumbsup:
